entities.name: Zulaport
entities.description: Coastal city on Beyeen, rebuilt after the Eldrazi tsunami as a floating settlement.

entities.name: Beyeen
entities.description: Island in Ondu on Zendikar where Zulaport lies.

entities.name: Indorel
entities.description: Powerful vampire who controlled Zulaport's economy and still lurks in its shadows.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient beings whose awakening brought a tsunami that devastated Zulaport.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: Nearby communities that helped rebuild Zulaport as a floating settlement.

events.summary: The Eldrazi awaken and a massive tsunami swallows much of Zulaport.
events.quote: devastation struck the city in the form of a massive tsunami that swallowed much of Zulaport

events.summary: Merfolk from nearby communities help rebuild Zulaport as a floating settlement.
events.quote: merfolk from nearby communities helped rebuild Zulaport as a floating settlement

events.summary: Indorel's stranglehold on Zulaport's commerce is broken.
events.quote: her stranglehold on its commerce has been broken

relations.note: Controlled its economy through thugs before the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Its thriving economy was controlled by the powerful vampire Indorel
Zulaport is a coastal city on the island of Beyeen
